description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 3 verified pearls and 1 agent under verification): A trust brief on one domain: when it was registered, its SPF and DMARC mail records, its TLS certificate, and (optional) whether AI crawlers may read it. What each step uses (as of 2026-11-18, version 2): registration date and registrar come from RDAP (a verified third-party agent); mail authentication reads the domain's published SPF and DMARC records from DNS (a verified third-party agent); the TLS step reads the certificate the site presents (our own agent); the AI crawler check is optional. Which fallback each step has is listed under the agents below. DKIM is not checked: a DKIM record can only be looked up with the sender's selector, which a domain does not publish. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. The tls step runs on our own agent; an external alternative is being added. Example arguments: {"domain":"python.org"}. Free to run for now. If that changes, we will say so on its page first. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent. Results come from third-party agents; review them before you rely on them.
